임무고 뭐고 모두 잊고 싶습니다. 이전 퀘스트에 대한 보상을 받고 싶습니: Forget the mission, forget everything. I just want the reward for my previous quest.
No, it's nothing. I was just saying it.
The mission is a bit much for me. I'll take it on again later.
정 그렇다면 할 수 없는 일이지. 하지만 말야 상사이기보다는 선배로써 충: If that's how you feel, there's nothing to be done. But let me give you a word of advice, not as your superior but as an elder - think it over once more.
I believe I did my best. I'd just like to receive my reward.
If it's your advice, I'll think it over once more.
내가 제군에게 임무를 맡겼던가? 내 정신이 이상해진 건가 아니면 제군이: Did I give you a mission? Am I losing my mind, or have you gotten something confused?
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올테니아'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없: The Free Combat Zone has 'Oltenia' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Choose one.
I'd like to go to Oltenia.
어서오시게나~ 바토리 쪽에서는 누가 가장 위대하던가? 브리콜라카스? 내: Welcome~ Who's the greatest on Bathory's side? Vrykolakas? There's little to learn from someone who can't even come close to me. I'll teach you things you can't learn from books. But... you're confident, aren't you?
I came because there's something I want to ask you.
Please teach me the great magics you know.
I'd like to see your weapons and beads.
I'd like to go to the Perona Highway.
I'd like to receive the test server gift.
더 연습한 후에 다시 오도록 하겠습니다. 그때는 당신의 제자로 받아주십시: I'll practice more and come back later. Please accept me as your disciple then.
역시 자네는 블러드님의 충실한 부하일세. 가서 그 간교한 바토리년의 목을: As expected, you're a loyal servant of Lord Vlad. Go and cut off that cunning Bathory witch's head. Ah! I nearly forgot something important. Do you know about the necklace that symbolizes the Masters? The Masters, who represent their races, each wear a necklace made of a pendant and bijou that can control and amplify their magical power.
Please tell me more about it.
알겠습니다. 이만 가 보겠습니다: Understood. I'll be on my way now.
우리의 블라드님에 대항하는 바토리와 질드레라는 자들이 있지. 그들 역시: There are those who oppose our Lord Vlad - Bathory and Gilles de Rais. They too are among the most cunning of the Vampire Masters, forever scheming to seize the Blood Scripture in pursuit of eternal, undying power. Ah! I nearly forgot something important. Do you know about the necklace that symbolizes the Masters? The Masters, who represent their races, each wear a necklace made of a pendant and bijou that can control and amplify their magical power.
팬던트와 비쥬는 모두 보석의 일종이라네. 상당한 마력을 갖고 있지. 모두: Both the pendant and the bijou are a kind of gem, each holding considerable magical power. Both are formidable, but the pendant is the core of the necklace - it plays the most central role in controlling magical power. A Master who loses it can no longer control their own power and will destroy themselves. If you want to catch that woman, simply killing her won't be enough. You must be sure to take that necklace from her as well.
I'd like to know the value of that necklace.
물질적인 것으로 계산한다고 해도 상당한 값을 하지만, 우리에게 있어서는: Even measured in material terms it's worth a great deal, but to us, isn't it worth even more than that? It's practically that woman's very life. Ha ha. If you have the pendant or bijou from that necklace, I'll trade you something finer than anything else I own. As you know, the pendant is more precious than the bijou. There's a difference between the two - do you wish to trade?
Yes, I'll trade Gilles de Rais's pendant.
Yes, I'll trade Gilles de Rais's bijou.
No. I'm sorry, but I don't wish to trade. I'll be on my way now.
Today too... for the great Lord Vlad... give it your all... heh heh~
If only we'd acted... just a little faster... we could have destroyed Bathory.
Be careful of Aiman. You never know when that one will stab you in the back.
위대한 블라드님을 위해서... 오늘도.. 많은 인간들을.. 우리 동족으로: For the great Lord Vlad... today too, we must turn many humans into our kind.
Isn't red blood beautiful? Everything can be made pure through blood.
바토리놈들을 없애야하네. 그놈들의 씨를 말려야 해!: We must wipe out Bathory's followers. We must exterminate them, root and all!
지금의 자신이 강하다고 생각하더라도, 무기와 비드를 사용한다면 더욱 강력: Even if you think you're strong now, using weapons and beads will let you unleash even greater power.
어려서부터 나는 랍비가 되려고 성경구절을 열심히 공부하고 스승님께서 가르: Ever since I was young, I studied scripture diligently to become a rabbi, memorizing again and again what my teacher taught me. But one day, a passage about atonement through blood struck me as strange. I must have been about fifteen then. All I knew back then was that atonement came through His great grace. But once I became fixated on the word 'blood'... I couldn't reach a conclusion. So from then on, I wandered from place to place, seeking true salvation through atonement. One day I met Lord Vlad, and as we spoke of blood... every single word of his struck a chord deep in my heart. When he finished speaking, he vanished before me without a trace. I searched for him for ten years. When I finally found him, I knelt before him and begged to be taken as his disciple. He alone... was my salvation...
그러셨군요. 그런데... 랍비는 어떤 사람을 가리키는 말입니까?: I see. But... what exactly does 'rabbi' mean?
I'm curious... what the battle against Bathory was like.
I'll be going now. Thank you for telling me.
궁금한 것이 있다구? 대체 자네의 궁금증을 어디 한번 들어볼까?: You have something you're curious about? Well then, let's hear it.
랍비셨다고 들었습니다. 랍비는 어떤 사람을 가리키는 말입니까?: I heard you were once a rabbi. What does 'rabbi' mean?
I'd like to hear about the battle against Bathory.
당신은...왜... 뱀파이어가 되었고 블라드님과는 어떻게 만나셨는지요?: Why... did you become a vampire, and how did you meet Lord Vlad?
Ah! I hope I haven't intruded on your precious time. I'll be going now.
랍비는 나의 선생님이라는 뜻의 헤브라이어로, 라보니(rabboni)라고도: 'Rabbi' is Hebrew for 'my teacher,' also called 'rabboni.' Anyone who wishes to become a rabbi must study a great deal of the Old Testament and the Talmud. A rabbi generally presides over Jewish religious events and various rites, and takes a wide part in educational activities. They're also involved in relief and service work for their community, and support all sorts of communal endeavors. I too... once, long ago... taught the word of God to others and served as His servant. Hmm... do you understand rabbis better now?
네.... 그런데... 왜.. 뱀파이어가 되셨고. 블라드님과는 어떻게 만: Yes... but... why did you become a vampire, and how did you meet Lord Vlad?
Kaim... I've taken up a great deal of your precious time... Well then... farewell.
바토리와의 전투라...참... 참담했지. 우리쪽 진영에서... 그 간사한: The battle against Bathory... it was truly dreadful. Because of that one conniving woman, our side lost many fine soldiers. Still, a few of Bathory's own - men marked for death - crawled over to our side and sold us information. We learned of a shortcut and were able to push into the lair quickly. What a shame, though. We should have finished Bathory off then. Even now she still lives, still troubling Lord Vlad. If only we'd been a little faster... we could have finished her. What a shame~
카임... 이만 가보겠습니다. 바토리놈들을... 하나라도.. 더 제거해야: Kaim... I'll be going now. I need to eliminate at least one more of Bathory's followers. Well then... take care.
You still lack blood. Go and drink more. A great deal more... heh heh heh.
어서오세요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?: Welcome. How may I help you?
I need something. Please show me your goods.
가지고 있는 물건들을 좀 팔고 싶습니다. 값을 후하게 쳐 주시겠습니까?: I'd like to sell some of my things. Could you give me a fair price?
I'd like to go to the Field Headquarters.
I'll come by another time. There's nothing I need right now.
Be careful. This place is always dangerous.
I'll pray that you return here alive.
전투 중에 입은 상처를 내버려 둔다면 뱀파이어가 될 가능성이 높으니 빨리: If wounds taken in battle are left untreated, there's a high chance of turning into a vampire, so they must be treated quickly.
당신들이 필요한 물건들을 구비해 놓고 있습니다. 필요한 것만 말씀해 주세: I have the supplies you need in stock. Just tell me what you require.
Many people have been badly wounded. We need to move them quickly and treat them.
Did you know? Blue Drop has another name - 'Adam's Tears.'
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올트'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없이: The Free Combat Zone has 'Olt' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Please choose.
감사합니다. %(UserName)님께서는 %(GuildName)의 팀원으: Thank you. %(UserName), as a member of %(GuildName), you are donating in the name of %(GuildName). The amount you've donated will be posted on the website under your team's name. The posted amount will be shown as a combined total. The precious donations gathered in the name of %(GuildName) will be put to good use wherever they're truly needed, wherever a helping hand is called for.
어떻게 여기까지 왔지? 저 길을 따라 왔다면, 자네 실력이 있는 걸? 엄: How did you make it here? If you came by that road, you must have some real skill - there are plenty of fearsome things lurking out there. So, what brings you to me?
물건을 보관하고 싶습니다. 보관함을 하나 주시겠습니까?: I'd like to store some items. Could you give me a storage box?
I'd like to check that my items are safe.
I need an accessory. Please show me what you have.
이 애물단지들이 말썽을 좀 부리는군요. 좀 고쳐주시겠습니까?: These troublesome things are acting up. Could you repair them for me?
I'd like to retrieve the motorcycle I left with you.
Ah, I came to the wrong place. Well then...
조심하게. 여긴 정신을 빼놓고 돌아다녀도 될 만한, 그런 만만한 곳이 아: Be careful. This isn't the kind of place where you can wander around with your guard down!
아무리 실력이 있어도 갑자기 뱀파이어의 공격을 받아 세상 하직하는 건 한: No matter how skilled you are, a sudden vampire attack can end your life in an instant.
You look like you're carrying a lot. Let me hold onto it - you just focus on the fight.
타인의 목숨만큼 자네 목숨도 중요하다는 것을 잊지 말게. 항상 조심하고!: Don't forget that your life matters just as much as anyone else's. Always be careful!
Bring me anything that needs repair. I'll fix it up good as new.
이곳에서 팔고 있는 악세사리들은 특별한 것이라네. 보통 다른 상점에서 보: The accessories sold here are special - items you don't usually find in other shops.
후후, 어쩐 일로 여기까지 오시었나~: Heh heh, what brings you all the way here~
혹시 쓸만한 물건들이 있나 해서 찾아왔습니다. 물건을 볼 수 있을까요?: I came to see if you have anything useful. Could I take a look at your goods?
I'd like to sell off some of my things.
I'd like to go inside Limbo Castle.
I'd like to go inside Lasen Castle.
I was passing by and stopped in to check on you. Well then...
슬레이어들을 쓸어주게. 자꾸 슬레이어들의 모습을 보면 웬지 불안해져서 말: Wipe out the Slayers for me. Somehow it unsettles me whenever I keep seeing them around.
If there's an accessory you need, tell me. I'll get it for you.
아직도 여기에 남은 인간들이 몇 있다고 하더군. 인간들 모두 종족으로 만: I hear there are still a few humans left around here. Turn every one of them into our kind.
그래야. 숫적으로 우세할 수 있을 거 같으니까 말야. 하하: That's right. That way we'll have the numbers on our side. Ha ha.
만약 자네에게 특별한 힘이 있다면, 블루 드롭이 자네를 더 강하게 만들어: If you have a special power, Blue Drop will make you even stronger.
내게 있는 물건은 더할 나위 없이 화려하고 대단한 것들이 많다네. 이 물: What I have are the finest, most splendid things you could ask for. It took a very long time to acquire them all.
나 말고도 림보성이나 라센성에서 특별한 아이템들을 판매하는 이들이 있다네: Besides me, there are others in Limbo Castle and Lasen Castle who sell special items. If you're interested, go take a look.
자유대결지대는 동족간의 대결을 위한 '올테니아'와 동족,타 종족에 관계없: The Free Combat Zone has 'Oltenia' for duels between your own kind, and 'Vanatul' where you can freely fight regardless of race. Choose one.
안녕하세요? 어떻게 여기까지 오셨나요? 슬레이어들이 나오는, 무시무시한: Hello there. How did you make it all the way here? Be careful of that terrifying road where the Slayers appear - we never know when they'll try to wipe us all out. Hmm, so why have you come?
혈청이나 씰 같은 것들을 사고 싶은데?: I'd like to buy some serum or seals.
물건 좀 보관하려는데, 보관함 하나 내어주겠니?: I want to store some items - could you give me a storage box?
I want to check on the items I stored before - show me.
그리피스, 이것 좀 고쳐주겠니?: Griffith, could you fix this for me?
I'd like to see the pet storage.
I was passing by and wanted to check that you're doing well.
Heavy items are a hassle to carry around. I'll keep them safe for you.
여긴 맘 놓고 인간들을 상대할 수 있어 재밌죠. 후훗: It's fun here - I can deal with the humans without a worry. Heh heh.
If you have anything that needs fixing, bring it here. I'll make it good as new.
좀 깨끗하게 사용해 주세요. 제가 고치지도 못할 정도로 만들어 놓으시면: Please take a bit better care of your things. Don't wreck them so badly that even I can't fix them.
My favorite color is red. It looks so delicious.
전투가 힘들어질 것 같으면, 저한테 혈청이랑 변신 아이템을 꼭 준비해서: If a fight looks like it's going to get tough, be sure to stock up on serum and transformation items from me. It'll help, even if just a little.
머피 아저씨가 갖고 있는 물건들은 상점에서 좀처럼 보기 힘들었던 좋은 것: Everything Mr. Murphy has is quality stuff you rarely see in shops. I wonder where he gets it all.
클랜 차원에서 모금에 참여할께: I'll take part in the fundraiser on behalf of the clan.
Then I'll donate as an individual.
Have you come to clear the red mark from your record? You know the procedure, right? So... how much do you want cleared?
I'd like to exchange stars for items.
I'd like to exchange stars for money.
I came here about my team.
팀 때문에 찾아왔다면, 구체적으로 어떤 사항에 대한 건가?: If you're here about your team, what exactly is it regarding?
I've come to register a team.
I'd like to view the pending team list.
I'd like to view the team list.
I'd like to leave the team.
탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각했다면 자네의 탈퇴 신청을 받아들이겠지만 이것: You want to leave? If you've thought it through carefully, I'll accept your request, but know this: after leaving a team, no other team will take you in right away. Even if you try to join elsewhere, a full week must pass in real time. Do you still wish to leave the team?
I understand, but I still wish to leave.
In that case, I'll think it over again.
나는 E.V.E 제 2부대 TEAM TWO 의 리더 알프레드 엠마뉴엘 스: I am Alfred Emmanuel Smith, leader of E.V.E. 2nd Squadron, Team Two. Just call me Smith.
For now, we're using this building as E.V.E.'s temporary base.
모든 것에 우선하는 것은, 뱀파이어들의 우두머리인 뱀파이어 마스터들을 처: Above all else, our priority is to destroy the Vampire Masters, the leaders of the vampires.
First, deal with the low-level vampires that have made their way into the village.
카이저 부대장님을 만나봤는가? 그분은 잘 계시던가?: Have you met Deputy Commander Kaiser? Is he doing well?
일단은 내가 임시 사령관직을 맡고 있으니 중요한 일이 있으면 꼭 보고하도: For now I'm serving as acting commander, so be sure to report to me if anything important comes up.
너무 어린 나이에 빨리 높은 자리에 오른다해도 별로 좋지는 않다네.. 그: Rising to a high position too young isn't necessarily a good thing... it comes with just as heavy a responsibility...
나약해져서는 안되네. 자기자신과의 싸움에서 진다면 자네는 이곳에서 그들에: You mustn't grow weak. If you lose the fight against yourself, you'll end up here as nothing more than a blood donor to them.
힘들고 어려울때 가족들의 얼굴을 떠올리게나. 나자신이 지켜야 할 무언가: When times are hard, picture your family's faces. If there's something you must protect, something you want to keep safe, fight hard and win.
그들을 없애고 싶다면 그들에 대한 미움을 키우게나. 그래야 자네가 더 강: If you want to destroy them, cultivate your hatred for them. Remember, that's what will make you stronger.
자신이 군인이라는 것을 항상 잊지말도록!: Never forget that you are a soldier!
고칠게 있으면 다 내게 가져와. 내 손이 닿는 순간, 뚝딱! 새 것처럼: Bring me anything that needs fixing. The moment my hands touch it - presto! Good as new... Come on, now...
There's something I'd like to ask.
I came here about my clan.
Yes. Please fix this for me.
혹시 내가 흥미있을 만한 것이 있나?: Is there anything here that might interest me?
이걸 팔고 싶군. 어때?: I'd like to sell this. What do you say?
클랜때문이라... 구체적으로 어떤 것을 원하는건가?: About your clan... what exactly do you need?
I've come to register a clan.
I'd like to view the pending clan list.
I'd like to view the clan list.
I'd like to leave the clan.
It seems there's nothing else I need here.
클랜을 탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각해 보았나? 음... 자네의 탈퇴 신청: You want to leave the clan? Have you thought it through carefully? Hmm... I'll accept your request, but know this: once you leave, no other clan will easily take you in. Since you're the one breaking the oath... even if you try to join elsewhere, a full week must pass in real time before it's possible.
림보성의 림보가 무슨뜻인줄 아는가? 바로 연옥이라는 뜻이지. 어때. 잘: Do you know what 'Limbo' in Limbo Castle means? It means purgatory. Well? Fitting name, isn't it?
뭐 고칠 게 있으면 내게 이야기하게: If you have anything that needs fixing, just tell me.
Lord Vrykolakas's hidden power is probably even greater than Lady Bathory's.
블라드 테페스가 우리 바토리님에게 한 짓을 자네 알고 있나?: Do you know what Vlad Tepes did to our Lady Bathory?
내게서 뭐가 궁금한 게지? 어디 한번 들어보지 뭐~: What is it you want to know from me? Well, let's hear it~
인간이었을 때 당신은 어떤 일을 하셨나요?: What did you do when you were human?
How did you come to meet Lady Bathory...
흑마법은 어떻게 배우셨나요?: How did you learn black magic?
I think I should be going now.
내 겉모습을 보면 무엇이었는지.. 알 것 같지 않나? 나는 부족의 샤먼의: Looking at my appearance, can't you guess what I was? I held the position of shaman in my tribe - an Indian who longed for eternal life. A bit unusual, isn't it? Most in my position take a great interest in the afterlife, but I have no interest in life after death.
음.. 바토리님은.. 내가 뱀파이어가 되도록 도와주신분일세. 그 분을 어: Hmm... Lady Bathory is the one who helped me become a vampire. How did I meet her, you ask? I followed Lord Vrykolakas, and there she was. I offered her my blood... and in return, I gained eternal life. After that, I became her servant of my own will.
인간이었을때 당신은 어떤 일을 하셨나요?: What did you do when you were human?
나는 살아 있을때가 중요하다고 생각하지. 그래서 내 삶을 좀 더 늘리고: I've always believed that life while you're living it is what matters most. So all I wanted was to extend my own life a little longer. Then it occurred to me that black magic might let me achieve what I wanted. So I traveled from place to place, studying black magic. Along the way... I met Lord Vrykolakas. Even now I consider meeting him a stroke of luck... anyone who studies magic has probably heard of him, the famous black magician. When I told him what I wanted, he asked me, 'If you get what you desire, you'll never see the sun again. Are you still willing?' I told him I was ready to sell even my own soul. So he took me somewhere... and this is what became of me.
가서.. 살아있는 것들의 피는 모조리 마셔버리게. 하하하: Go now... drink every last drop of blood from the living. Ha ha ha.
오늘도.. 많은 인간들을.. 블라드님의 발앞에 엎드리게 만들었느냐? 블라: Have you again today made many humans kneel before Lord Vlad's feet? Before Lord Vlad sees for himself... I will inspect your harvest first. If the count isn't enough... you'll die by my hand!
Lord Aiman. I've come to you because there's something I'd like to ask. If I'm interrupting... I apologize, but would you help satisfy my curiosity?
I'd like to purchase blood crystals, seals, and the like.
아이만님. 제 물건들을... 보관하여 주시겠습니까?: Lord Aiman. Would you... keep my belongings safe for me?
I've come to get something repaired. Please fix this for me.
I'll go out and capture some humans. Well then...
클랜을 탈퇴하겠다고? 신중하게 생각해 보았다면 알겠네. 자네의 탈퇴 신청: You want to leave the clan? If you've thought it over carefully, then you understand. I'll accept your request to withdraw. But know this: leaving here doesn't mean you can join another clan right away. Since you broke the oath with your own hands, it'll take a full week in real time before you can go elsewhere. It won't be that easy~
무엇이냐? 네가 궁금해 하는 것이.... 어떤 것이냐? 어서 말해보아라!: What is it? Whatever you're curious about... what is it? Speak up, quickly!
인간이었을적엔 어떤 일을 하셨나요?: What did you do when you were human?
아이만님. 어떻게 이곳으로 오게 되셨나요?: Lord Aiman, how did you come to be here?
왜 카임과 사이가 안좋은 거죠?: Why don't you get along with Kaim?
당신을 귀찮게 해드려서.... 죄송합니다. 아이만님. 이만 물러가보겠습니: I'm sorry for troubling you... Lord Aiman. I'll take my leave now.
내가 인간이었을적이라... 얼마안되서... 기억이 생생하지. 내 모습을: Me, when I was human... it wasn't long ago... the memories are still vivid. Just look at me and you'll understand. That's right, I was a battle commander of Aljihad. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say I was the one behind countless wars and countless lives lost. And... even now... heh heh... I'm still killing humans. For every enemy I destroyed, I lost that many more of my own men. None of the comrades who remained back then are alive today, because with my own hands I offered their blood to Lord Vlad. Once I offered those I thought of as family to Lord Vlad, my heart grew much lighter. Hmm~ And even now, I strive to offer the blood of even more humans to him. Heh heh...
내가 이곳으로 오게된 연유를 알고싶은게냐? 네놈은 별걸 다 알고 싶어하는: You want to know how I came to be here? Seems there's no end to what you want to know. I came here through the grace of the great Lord Vlad. Four years ago, when my army got caught up in a conflict in the Middle East, I first met Lord Vlad in the field of operations. That day, I could feel the calm after battle in his presence, and his intense charisma shook both my mind and my spirit. What snapped me out of that daze was the sight of my own men dying before me. The sight of him feeding on my subordinates struck me powerfully. And so, from that moment on, I followed him. And... that's how I ended up here.
아이만님. 인간이었을적엔 어떤일을 하셨나요?: Lord Aiman, what did you do when you were human?
왜 카임과 사이가 안좋나요?: Why don't you get along with Kaim?
Sorry for continuing to bother you...
So even you already know about the bad blood between Kaim and me. If you ask me, I think it's because he and I serve the same lord. When I spoke with him, I realized it — his passion for Lord Vlad is no less than mine. He's desperate to win Lord Vlad's trust too... Tch! I need to get rid of him soon! If he didn't rely on magic, he'd fall in a single blow. What a shame. Tsk~
그래~ 오늘도 가서... 바토리놈들을... 하나라도.. 더 없애고 오너라: Good~ Go out today too, and eliminate at least one more of those Bathory scum! I'll be watching you!
Yes! Understood. I'll be on my way, then.
선물은 유감스럽지만, 모두에게 나누어 줄 수는 없어서 말이지.. 이번에: Unfortunately, this gift can't be given to everyone. It's a special gift made this time as a premium service for players who've enjoyed the game. If you don't qualify to receive it, I'm sorry, but please go back.
선물은 목걸이나 팔찌, 링 중의 하나이며, 옵션이 두개 붙은 레어 악세서: The gift is one of a necklace, bracelet, or ring — a rare accessory with two options attached. Keep in mind that the tier of the accessory and the quality of its options improve the higher your level is. And this gift is given only once.
Yes, understood. Please give me the gift.
블라드님과 함께라면... 언제나... 어디서나... 두려울 게 없지!: With Lord Vlad by my side, anytime, anywhere, there's nothing to fear!
블라드 님은 나의 은인이시다~ 함부로 그분을 욕되게 한다면... 참지 않: Lord Vlad is my benefactor~ If anyone dares to disgrace him, I won't stand for it.
우리들에게 은총을 베푸시는 블라드님을 위해... 나가서... 많은 인간들: For the sake of Lord Vlad, who bestows his grace upon us, go out and drink the blood of many humans to turn them to our side! (?)
눈엣가시인 ... 카임을 내 언젠가... 손봐주리라~: That thorn in my side... Kaim... one day I'll deal with him~
전부중에 피가 필요하게 될 것이다. 치열한 전투를 치르기 전에는 나에게: You'll need blood before this is through. Be sure to stop by me and prepare before you head into fierce battle.
프리야에게서 원하는 악세서리를 구하지 못했다면, 림보성이나 페로나로 가: If you couldn't get the accessory you wanted from Priya, try going to Limbo Castle or Perona.
자네, 뭘 알고 있는 사람이군. 그래.. 그 놈들에게 죽어간 사람들이 한: You seem to know a thing or two. Yes, those killed by them are not few. Master-class vampires each claim their own territory, and they're always itching to devour one another given half a chance. Just when things seemed to calm down, I hear they've started moving again. To control their own power, they rely on gemstones imbued with magic. Each Master possesses a necklace made from these gems, and they're all bloodthirsty over claiming each other's.
목걸이는 말이지. 팬던트 부분과 비쥬들로 이루어져 있지. 각각의 보석들이: The necklace, you see, is made up of a pendant and bijoux. Each gem holds great magical power, but the pendant is truly the essence of that power. The necklace itself is worth a fortune in gems, but it could also serve as vital research material for us to wipe out the vampires. It might even reveal the source of their power. I'd love to see it with my own eyes while I'm still alive.
I'd like to know more about the necklace's worth.
허허. 자네에게 그 목걸이가 있다면 내 아주 값진 아이템들과 바꾸어 주겠: Heh heh. If you have that necklace, I'll trade it for some very valuable items of mine. Of course, the item's value will depend on whether it's the pendant or the bijou. So, what do you say?
I'd like to trade my pendant for an item.
I'd like to trade my bijou for an item.
죄송하지만, 다시 생각해 보겠습니다: I'm sorry, but I'll think about it a bit more.
자네는 바토리를 위하여 목숨을 걸 각오가 되어 있는가? 그렇다면 가르쳐: Are you prepared to risk your life for Bathory? If so, I'll tell you. The Masters of our race each have a necklace that symbolizes them. That necklace is made of a pendant and bijoux, and the gems that make it up hold powerful magic. The Masters use this necklace to freely control and channel their power.
우리가 섬기고 있는 바토리님과 같은 뱀파이어 마스터들은 모두 열두 명이: It's said there are twelve vampire Masters in all, just like our own Lord Bathory. They too are said to be scheming, ever on the lookout for a chance to seize the Blood Scripture in pursuit of eternal power. So far, we've managed to pinpoint the hideouts of two Masters — Tepes, who's holed up in Larsen Castle, and Gildre, south of Lake Timor. The Masters of our vampire clan each have a necklace that symbolizes them. That necklace is made of a pendant and bijoux, and the gems that make it up hold powerful magic. The Masters use this necklace to freely control and channel their power.
이 목걸이에서 특별히 펜던트 부분은 마력의 결정체라고 할 수 있지. 제: Of this necklace, the pendant especially can be called the crystallization of magical power. No matter how powerful a Master may be, if he loses the pendant, he loses control of himself and becomes powerless. If you truly wish to destroy Tepes, you'll need to take not just his head, but his necklace as well. It's been a very long time since I've seen that necklace with my own eyes.
I'd like to know about the worth of a Master's necklace.
그렇군요. 꼭 보실 수 있으시길 빕니다: I see. I hope you get to see it someday.
값어치가.. 단순히 물질적으로 말할 수 없을 정도로 중요한 것이지. 자네: Its worth is too great to be measured in mere material terms. If you have the pendant or bijou from that necklace, I'll trade it for something far more precious than ordinary goods. Of course, the exchange will vary depending on whether it's the pendant or the bijou. Shall we?
Yes, I'd like to trade Tepes's pendant.
Yes, I'd like to trade Tepes's bijou.
Yes, I'd like to trade Gildre's pendant.
Yes, I'd like to trade Gildre's bijou.
No. I'm sorry, but I can't trade it. I'll be going now.
마스터께서 이상해지셨어. 대체 무슨 일이 있었던 걸까… 하지만 그렇다고: The Master has been acting strangely. I wonder what could have happened... But even so, to have me standing among those merchants... Hmm? Did you just say something to me?
Yes, I came because there's something I'd like to ask.
Rebecca, I'd like you to adjust my alignment.
무기와 비드를 보고 싶은데, 보여주겠나?: I'd like to see your weapons and beads — will you show me?
I'd like to exchange the blood stones I've collected.
No, I was just passing through.
좋아요. 하지만 저와 대화할 시간이 길게 주어질 수 없다는 것쯤은 잘 아: Very well. But I trust you understand I can't spare much time to talk.
알겠습니다, 레베카. 흐흠, 저… 당신은 마스터와 어떻게 만나게 되셨습니: Understood, Rebecca. Ahem, um... how did you come to meet the Master?
알겠습니다. 그럼 이만…: Understood. I'll take my leave, then...
호호호호… 궁금하다 것이 고작 바토리 님과 만나게 된 연유입니까? 이상한: Ho ho ho ho... All you're curious about is how I came to meet Lord Bathory? A strange question, but since you're curious, I suppose I'll answer. I first met the Master about 40 years ago. Back then I had just been born a vampire and was wandering aimlessly, when she took me in and taught me a great many things.
그렇다면 혹시 피의 성서에 대해 아십니까?: In that case, do you happen to know about the Blood Scripture?
마스터의 은총을 받으셨군요. 마스터께서 친히 마법을 가르쳐 주시던가요?: So you've received the Master's grace. Did she personally teach you magic?
Yes, understood. I've talked too much. I'll be going now.
피의 성서는 우리들 사이에서 '성전'이라 불리지요. 그것만 있으면 이 세: The Blood Scripture is called the 'Holy Book' among us. With it alone, this world could become ours. But beyond that, I don't know much myself.
저는 이만 가보는 게 좋을 것 같습니다. 그럼 안녕히…: I think I'd best be going now. Farewell, then...
물론 가르쳐 주셨지요. 그저 제가 강해지기만을 바라면서요. 한가지 아쉬운: Of course she taught me. She only ever wished for me to grow stronger. If there's one regret, it's that I still haven't received Lord Vrykolakas's magic. I'm counting the days until I can learn magic from him — the one who taught the Master, and the strongest vampire of all.
저는 그분께 마법을 직접 전수 받았습니다만 레베카님은... 아직이시라니: I received magic directly from him myself, so it's a bit surprising to hear that you, Lady Rebecca, have not yet.
I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time. I'll be going now.
예, 아쉽게도 그분의 마법은 전수 받지 못했지요. 저도 당신처럼 그분께: Yes, unfortunately I haven't been taught his magic. Like you, I too wish to learn powerful black magic from him. Even if he refuses to teach me, I'll find a way to learn it one way or another.
여부가 있겠습니까. 시간을 많이 빼앗았으니 그럼 전 이만…: Of course. I've taken up too much of your time, so I'll be off now...
악질 뱀파이어께서… 드디어 납시었군. 약간만 기부를 하시면 성향을 조정해: The wicked vampire has finally arrived... Make a modest donation and I'll adjust your alignment. Keep in mind the result varies with the amount you donate.
이런 제 주머니 사정으론 어림도 없겠군요. 돈을 좀 모아 다시 오겠습니다: Hmm, that's far more than I can afford right now. I'll save up some money and come back.
어째서 마스터의 심기가 불편해지신 걸까… 행여 내가 무슨 잘못이라도 저지: Why has the Master's mood soured so? I wonder if I've done something wrong...
레어 안에서 여기까지 들려오는 저 소리는 대체 뭐지? 바토리 님은 괜찮으: What in the world is that sound coming all the way from inside the lair? I wonder if Lord Bathory is all right.
I hear the Ousters' barrier was created by that witch-like woman, Carisas.
블라드 녀석이 요즘 수상한 기미를 보인다고 하던데…: I hear that Vlad fellow has been acting suspicious lately...
행여나 마스터의 신변을 위협하는 녀석이 생긴다면 내 친히 피를 말려주도록: If anyone ever dares threaten the Master's safety, I'll personally drain them dry.
그 귀찮기 짝이 없는 결계만 없었어도 벌써 예전에 아우스터즈들의 피로 성: If it weren't for that endlessly annoying barrier, we could've held a grand feast with the Ousters' blood long ago.
난 대체 언제까지 이런 곳에 있어야만 하는 거지?: Just how much longer do I have to stay in a place like this?
There's never been anyone who fell out of the Master's favor and didn't end up wishing for death.
블라드 발 밑에서 살살거리는 놈들은 죄다 바토리 님의 욕조 속에서 섞이게: Every last one of those toadies groveling at Vlad's feet will end up mixed into Lord Bathory's bathtub, mark my words.
글쎄… 얘기한들 알 수 나 있으려나 몰라. 전설로 전해지던 '아우스터즈': Well... I wonder if telling you would even make sense to you. It seems quite likely that the 'Ousters' — those half-vampires from legend — aren't just a made-up tale after all. And apparently these creatures hold a grudge against us. We're currently investigating them, so you'd best work hard at it.
I see, so that's how it was.
According to legend, the Ousters were victims once bitten by vampires. Before they could turn into vampires themselves, they sought the help of Carisas, a famed shamaness of the time, to try to become human again. But in the end, they're nothing more than half-vampires. They have eternal life and cannot drink blood, yet they're unaffected by sunlight, they say. Still, why so many of them suddenly appeared all at once remains a mystery.
나는 더 이상 알고 있는 정보가 없어요. 림보성 남동에 있는 라르바를 찾: I don't have any more information than that. Go seek out Larva, southeast of Limbo Castle. He's a filthy piece of work... I still wonder why Lord Bathory entrusted him with this task.
아우스터즈들한테 관심이 있다니 다행이군요. 하지만 저는 당신이 이번 일을: I'm glad you're interested in the Ousters. Still, I have my doubts about whether you can properly carry out this task. Perhaps a small test would be in order.
Of course. Just tell me what it is.
I'll replenish my magic and come back.
이제 당신을 믿을 수 있겠군요. 먼저 조사를 시작한 동지들의 보고에 의하: Now I think I can trust you. According to reports from those who began investigating first, there's a resident who claims to have seen something strange — not a vampire, yet too bizarre to be human. They've only learned that there's a witness, but haven't made direct contact yet. You need to find that witness and gather information. Can you carry out this task?
라르바를 찾아가도록 하세요. 림보성 남동에 있죠. 조심하세요. 절대로 그: Go seek out Larva. He's southeast of Limbo Castle. Be careful — you must never let yourself be swayed by his words.
나는 더 이상 당신한테 줄 임무가 없습니다. 라르바가 당신에게 임무를 주: I have no more tasks to give you. Didn't Larva give you a task?
하고 있던 일은 어떻게 된거죠? 그것이나 마치고 오는게 어떨까요?: What happened to the task you were working on? Why don't you finish that first?
So you've completed the task. Why don't you go ahead and receive your reward first.
훌륭합니다. 바토리님도 안심하실 겁니다. 하지만 테스트를 받았다고 해서: Excellent. Lord Bathory will be relieved as well. But just because you took the test doesn't mean you're obligated to carry out the task. Simply taking the test is enough to receive the reward Lord Bathory grants. Whether to undertake the actual task is entirely your choice. So then, will you take the reward, or will you carry out Lord Bathory's orders and take on the official task?
당신이 가져온 정보는 매우 유용한 것이었습니다. 그럼 다음 임무도 수행하: The information you brought was very useful. So I take it you're ready for the next task as well. As before, you're not obligated to carry it out. Simply having accomplished this task is enough for Lord Bathory to be pleased and grant you a reward. The next task will be even more dangerous and difficult. Whether to take on this order is entirely your choice. So then, will you take the reward, or will you carry out the next task? I'd like to see your loyalty.
Whatever Lord Bathory commands, I'm ready.
Honestly, this task was already a lot for me to handle. I'd like to take the reward.
Looking at this, it doesn't seem to be a task I assigned.
보상이라고요? 라르바를 찾아가야 하는게 아닌가요?: A reward, you say? Shouldn't you go find Larva?
Yes, it seems there's been a mistake.
바토리님은 거짓말을 매우 싫어합니다. 임무를 완수하신 후에 보상을 바라도: Lord Bathory despises lies. Please complete the task before expecting a reward.
Hmm... giving up over something this trivial... I'm starting to doubt your loyalty. Do you really intend to give up?
No, not at all. Please give me one more chance to prove my loyalty.
제가 당신에게 임무를 맡겼던가요?: Did I actually assign you a task?
Ah, it seems there's been some mistake.
예? 이미 훌륭하게 완수한 임무를 놔두고 왜 포기란 말을 하고 계시는 것: What? Why speak of giving up when you've already completed the task splendidly? Just go ahead and take your reward.
아우스터즈의 결계를 부수고 싶다는 의지가 있다니 다행이군요. 하지만 저는: I'm glad to see you have the will to break the Ousters' barrier. Still, I have my doubts about whether you can properly carry out this task. Perhaps a small test to gauge your wisdom would be in order.
요점만 설명하겠어요. 우리는 마력을 감지할 수 있는 펜듀럼이 급히 필요합: I'll get straight to the point. We urgently need a pendulum that can detect magical power. But to use it, we need a dowsing rod made from a special mineral. Can you gather 10 pieces of this mineral?
%(QuestZone)에서 %(Target) 8개를 찾아올 수 있습니까?: Can you go to %(QuestZone) and bring back 8 %(Target)?
여러분들의 수고로 광물조각은 충분히 마련할 수 있었습니다. 하지만 이를: Thanks to everyone's efforts, we were able to gather enough mineral fragments. But to refine them, we're told we need a substance called Refinium. Apparently it can only be obtained from a certain mine northeast of Limbo Castle. I hear the place is guarded against intruders with invisible walls and traps, so please be especially careful. What do you say?
펜듀럼과 다우징을 이용하여 조사한 결과 아우스터즈의 결계를 부술 열쇠가담: Using the pendulum and dowsing rod, our investigation revealed the location of a clay doll that will lead us to the grimoire holding the key to breaking the Ousters' barrier. This clay doll has been broken into pieces and scattered across the various regions of Eslania. Can you gather all the fragments of the clay doll and put it back together?
Gather all the fragments of the shattered clay doll in %(QuestZone) and bring them back.
다행히도 마도서를 찾는 데는 성공했습니다. 하지만 이를 해석하기 위해서: Fortunately, we succeeded in finding the grimoire. But to decipher it, we need to find five kinds of magic stones and complete a code table. To complete the correct code table, you'll need to combine the spells engraved on the stones, fitting each one in while avoiding the spells of adjacent stones above, below, left, and right. I think it should become intuitive once you take a good look at the code table. Please give it your all to the very end, for Lord Bathory's sake. What do you say? If it's all right, go ahead and take the code table.
